subject: [AMBER] facing problem in installation of Amber18 with CUDA support

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Dear Users/Developers,
As I have followed the Amber archive
thoroughly regarding this problem, I saw that there is a related problem
(with different CUDA version though but I think that's not a problem here
or is it?) and in connection to that I am attaching the simulationConst.h
file here from my $AMBERHOME/src/pmemd/src/cuda directory. Please help me
to solve this problem.
regards,
Satyajit Khatua

messages.author: David Cerutti
messages.body:
simulationConst.h was part of the CUDA in Amber distribution 16 and
earlier.  We are about to do a code freeze for Amber20, and 19 has been out
for almost a year.  What problem are you referring to?
On Thu, Feb 20, 2020 at 1:55 AM SATYAJIT KHATUA <satyajitkhatua09.gmail.com>
wrote:

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
Thank u for your reply sir. The problem that I have faced maybe related
to some miscommunications between system OS libiraries (our system has
CentOS 8 then) and Amber18. When we have changed that to CentOS 7 and then
compiled Amber18 in our servers with CUDA10.2, It was installed with no
sign of errors and working properly now.
Thanks a lot,
Satyajit Khatua
